name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.87 / build 88 packages current Mobile changes, including read-only multi-service medical results, service-linked image/PDF viewing and direct Android result-PDF downloads. Existing medical forms, photos, legal notices and staff support are retained. TypeScript and 19 focused history/PDF tests passed. Actual package version, signature continuity, all 128 unchanged source files, native modules and both clinic PDF templates were verified; 35 previous APKs were preserved. This APK publication does not deploy the backend, provision file storage, enable billing, reset data or delete accounts/records. Result attachments require the matching backend and approved private storage. Existing development/test signing retained; no physical-phone installation or production/Play Store signing is claimed. Install over a compatible app without uninstalling or clearing data.
